name: Shared Soundboard
description: Cross-platform default-output playback using node-web-audio-api; Linux routing is provided by a separate plugin.

guide.title: Play sounds on your deck
guide.intro: Default-output playback is supported on Linux, Windows and macOS when the shared audio backend is available. Named outputs and virtual microphone routes are Linux Audio features, not cross-platform features.

steps.title: Enable and check playback
steps.text: Enable Shared Soundboard, restart MacroMaxx, and check the backend status below.

steps.title: Assign a sound
steps.text: Add a Soundboard action in Deck Editor, choose an audio file, leave the route at default output, then test the key.

steps.title: Optional Linux routing
steps.text: For playback into a voice app, enable Linux Audio and follow its virtual microphone guide. Basic speaker playback does not require Linux Audio.
